note: The city is the Chittagong City Corporation (CCC). It is divided into police Stations and 41 wards. A ward that the source places in more than one Station is listed under each of them, so a business that delivers to any of those Stations is matched for that ward. Karnaphuli Station is part of the Chittagong Metropolitan Police but lies outside the City Corporation, so it is not listed.

areas.name: Chittagong City Corporation (CCC)
areas.source: The whole city. Every listing delivers to the whole CCC area unless the business reports a smaller area. No boundary yet, so matching is by name only.
